Precondition: Any LOT created in the system
Step: Attempt to create a LOT with a duplicate LOT name
Expected Result: System rejects the duplicate; LOT names are unique and conform to the MPP format

Precondition: A LOT exists
Step: Open the LOT detail and compare the LOT ID and LOT Name
Expected Result: LOT ID is used as the LOT Name (identical)

Precondition: A LOT exists
Step: Review the LOT attributes on LOT detail
Expected Result: Part number, piece count, max piece count, serial range (where applicable), weight, vendor lot, and hold state are all present

Precondition: A LOT exists
Step: Change a LOT attribute (e.g. piece count) as an authorized user
Expected Result: The change is recorded in the LOT attribute-change history with old/new value, user, and station

Precondition: Logged in as an operator without elevation
Step: Attempt a restricted LOT-attribute change
Expected Result: Change is blocked/elevation-gated; when performed it is audited with the logged-in user and terminal

Precondition: A LOT with sufficient pieces
Step: Split the LOT into sub-LOTs
Expected Result: Sub-LOT → parent relationship is retained; genealogy edge and closure are recorded

Precondition: Two same-part Good LOTs meeting merge rules
Step: Merge the LOTs into a new LOT
Expected Result: A new LOT is created; merge rules (part match, die-rank, quality status) are enforced; genealogy retained

Precondition: A LOT that has been split/consumed
Step: Open the genealogy view and trace backward
Expected Result: Full genealogy is presented back to the originating LOT(s)

Precondition: A LOT with production/movement/reject history
Step: Open LOT detail history
Expected Result: Complete process history + genealogy for the life of the LOT is shown, timestamps in Eastern time

Precondition: A finished-good LOT with full genealogy
Step: Request the genealogy report and export
Expected Result: Report is viewable on screen and exports to Excel or PDF; selectable by serial/lot/sub-lot

Precondition: A LOT with a quality result that is later split
Step: Split the inspected LOT and view the sub-LOT
Expected Result: Quality-result linkage is preserved through the split

Precondition: A produced die-cast part
Step: Trace the part genealogy toward raw material
Expected Result: Aluminum ingots are NOT part of the produced-part genealogy (correctly absent)

Precondition: A batch of pre-printed LTT barcodes; none pre-registered
Step: Scan an unused LTT to create a LOT then rescan an already-used one
Expected Result: Creating on first scan succeeds (no pre-registration); rescanning a used LTT is rejected as duplicate

Precondition: A LOT with production + consumption events
Step: Open LOT detail and read TotalInProcess and InventoryAvailable
Expected Result: Both derive live from the v_LotDerivedQuantities view (event tables), not materialized columns; values reconcile with the events

Precondition: No LOT pre-exists for an operation
Step: Create the LOT at the moment of the operator's first action
Expected Result: The LOT record is created on demand at operator action (lazy), never pre-provisioned

Precondition: A LOT with multi-level genealogy
Step: Open the genealogy report/view
Expected Result: The report presents the full parent/child tree with production events and is viewable on screen

Precondition: Two LOTs proposed for merge that have not completed sort/inspection
Step: Attempt the merge
Expected Result: Merge is gated — LOTs must satisfy the post-sort requirement before merging

Precondition: Two LOTs of different part numbers
Step: Attempt to merge them
Expected Result: Merge is rejected — only same-part-number LOTs may merge

Precondition: Two same-part LOTs from incompatible die ranks
Step: Attempt to merge them
Expected Result: Merge is rejected on die-rank incompatibility (DieRankCompatibility); a supervisor override is available where policy allows

Precondition: Two LOTs where one is not Good
Step: Attempt to merge them
Expected Result: Merge is rejected — all merge inputs must be Good (non-Good blocked)

Precondition: A machining line consuming multiple castings
Step: Inspect how machining combines input LOTs
Expected Result: Machining uses FIFO-by-cavity consume-mint, not a merge; no merge genealogy record is created

Precondition: A LOT produced by a merge
Step: Inspect the merged output LOT's tool/cavity
Expected Result: Merged LOT has NULL Tool/Cavity (provenance preserved via genealogy to the inputs)

Precondition: A serialized part with a known serial
Step: Search by serial number in the trace/search tool
Expected Result: The serialized part resolves with its producing LOT and container

Precondition: A known container
Step: Search by container / AIM shipper id
Expected Result: The container resolves with its contents and shipping label

Precondition: A LOT known by LOT/part/vendor
Step: Search by LOT number, part number, or vendor lot
Expected Result: Matching LOTs are returned with status and location

Precondition: LOTs in process across the plant
Step: Open the in-process LOT report
Expected Result: Active LOTs are listed with their current location and status

Precondition: LOTs/containers on hold
Step: Open the hold status report
Expected Result: Open holds are listed with type, reason, age, and subject

Precondition: Shipped containers over a date range
Step: Open the shipping history report
Expected Result: Shipped containers list with AIM shipper id, part, quantity, and ship time

Precondition: The plant-floor home screen
Step: Open the Global Trace tool from the home tile
Expected Result: A Trace tile/entry point is present and opens the Global Trace tool

Precondition: The Global Trace tool
Step: Enter a trace identifier (LOT / serial / container / part)
Expected Result: The tool accepts and resolves multiple identifier types

Precondition: A resolved trace subject
Step: Produce the trace output and export
Expected Result: Full upstream/downstream genealogy is displayed and exports to Honda-format PDF/CSV

Precondition: A trace/quality condition raising a notification
Step: Observe the MVP notification posture
Expected Result: Notifications surface as in-app banners only (no email/SMS) in MVP

Precondition: System seeded
Step: Inspect the IdentifierSequence table
Expected Result: MESL (LOT) and MESI (serialized) sequences are seeded with their formats

Precondition: Concurrent LOT creation
Step: Mint identifiers under concurrent load
Expected Result: IdentifierSequence_Next issues gap-free unique values under row-locking; no duplicates under concurrency

Precondition: Cutover checklist
Step: Verify the identifier sequences are seeded to the agreed cutover start values
Expected Result: Sequences start at the MPP-agreed cutover values (e.g. a +10,000 offset) so new IDs never collide with legacy

Precondition: A LOT with recorded production events
Step: Attempt to alter or delete a posted production/genealogy event; then record a correction
Expected Result: Evidence and traceability records cannot be updated or deleted; the correction is written as a NEW event, leaving the original intact (append-only)
